name: Easy aerobic run
focus: Aerobic base, conversational Zone 1-2, habit establishment

steps.description: Z1 walk-to-jog transition, <145 bpm, let legs wake up
Z2 aerobic, 146-162 bpm, conversational pace, slow down if HR climbs above 162
Z1 shuffle or brisk walk, let HR fall below 130

name: Easy aerobic flush
focus: Active recovery, aerobic flush, 85-95 rpm, legs only

steps.description: Z1 spin, high cadence 85-90 rpm, minimal resistance, <145 bpm
Z2 aerobic, 146-162 bpm, 85-95 rpm, no strain — soreness in legs should ease within 5 min
Z1 spin-down, reduce resistance fully, HR below 120 before stopping

name: Lower body and core circuit
focus: Lower-body strength and core stability, shoulder-safe throughout
notes: 3 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg dumbbells, 8x TRX split squat each leg (replace with reverse lunge if shoulder discomfort), 15x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug each side, 30s plank. 45-60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. No overhead or heavy shoulder loading.

steps.description: Leg swings 10 each direction each leg, hip circles 10 each direction, 10x bodyweight squat slow, 10x glute bridge on floor
3 rounds: goblet squat 16kg x10, RDL 16kg x10, TRX split squat 8 each leg, banded glute bridge x15, dead bug 8 each side, plank 30s. 45-60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds.
Hip flexor stretch 30s each side, seated hamstring stretch 30s each side, supine glute stretch 30s each side, cat-cow 10 breaths

name: Long easy aerobic ride
focus: Primary aerobic base session — sustained Zone 2, 65 min unbroken, mitochondrial development

steps.description: Z1 build, start free-spinning 5 min then gradually add light resistance, cadence 80-90 rpm, <145 bpm by end of warmup
Z2 sustained aerobic block, 146-162 bpm, 85-95 rpm, do not drift into Z3 — reduce resistance if power creeps above 141W. Check HR every 20 min: in range + conversational = continue.
Z1 spin-down, progressively reduce resistance, HR below 120 before stopping, walk 2 min after dismounting
